- [RLOW.6.4.2] A site with a numeric or string spec, or with no spec, compiles
  to a `value` primitive (`proto/rete_expr.proto#ValuePrim`) whose fields hold
  the spec's parts ([LGRA.2.9.6.5]): alignment, `+`, `0`, width, precision and
  type. A site with no spec leaves every field at its zero value, which renders
  the value's canonical text ([LGRA.2.9.6.10]).
